Projects

P-01 CFD Aerodynamics Jan 2024 – Apr 2025

CFD Analysis of NACA 0012 Airfoil with Slotted Flap

Conducted a full CFD study on the NACA 0012 airfoil across an angle-of-attack range of 0° to 20°, capturing coefficient of lift and drag alongside detailed flow visualisation. A slotted flap variant was modelled and compared against the baseline — quantifying the percentage increase in lift and drag, and examining differences in velocity contours and pressure distribution around both configurations.

Designed the slotted flap geometry in SolidWorks and executed the full simulation pipeline in Ansys Fluent, from mesh generation through post-processing of results.

Experience

Aerospace Engineering Intern
Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) — Koraput Division
May 2023 – Jun 2023

HAL Koraput is one of India's premier defence aerospace facilities, specialising in the manufacture and overhaul of high-performance military jet engines. The division is the sole production centre for the AL-31FP turbofan engine — the powerplant behind the Indian Air Force's Su-30MKI fleet — with over 535 units manufactured and 900+ overhauled to date, each rated at 12,500 kgf thrust.

// aircraft · Su-30MKI

The Su-30MKI is the IAF's primary air superiority fighter. Exposure to its turbofan assembly line provided a rare glimpse into defence-grade turbomachinery manufacturing at production scale.

  • Gained hands-on exposure to turbomachinery assembly and manufacturing processes for the AL-31FP jet engine in a high-precision defence aerospace environment.
  • Observed and documented engineering workflows, safety practices, and system integration protocols across production lines.
  • Prepared a detailed technical report on project management practices, demonstrating proficiency in MS Office tools.
  • Collaborated directly with engineers across teams, building practical understanding of real-world aerospace operations at one of India's leading defence manufacturers.
